name: Bitrix24
description: Bitrix24 is a business workspace combining customer relationship management, sales pipelines, tasks, collaboration, communications, sites, stores, automation, and administration. Teams use its CRM to organize deals and coordinate customer work inside a portal.
agentUseSummary: Create one dedicated least-privilege Bitrix24 cloud incoming webhook, save its secret URL once, and let agents use three approval-gated bounded reads for the webhook owner and Deal summaries. Relay excludes contacts, companies, leads, communications, files, products, custom fields, mutations, arbitrary REST methods, pagination, and exports.

credentialRequirements.label: Bitrix24 incoming webhook URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated incoming webhook with CRM permission. The URL contains its secret; Relay stores the complete value encrypted and never returns it to agents.

capabilities.label: Read webhook owner
capabilities.description: Read bounded identity metadata for the exact user who owns the incoming webhook.

capabilities.label: Read deals
capabilities.description: List bounded Deal summaries or inspect one exact Deal without contact, company, communication, product, file, or custom-field data.

approvalRequired.label: Read webhook owner
approvalRequired.description: Read the bounded basic profile for the exact incoming-webhook owner.

approvalRequired.label: List deals
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five bounded Deal summaries from the first fixed page.

approvalRequired.label: Read deal
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact bounded Deal by positive numeric ID.

blocked.label: Change Bitrix24 data
blocked.description: Creating, updating, moving, converting, merging, or deleting CRM records is outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private CRM data
blocked.description: Contacts, companies, leads, phone numbers, email addresses, comments, activities, files, products, custom fields, and communications are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader workspace data
blocked.description: Tasks, users beyond the webhook owner, chats, calls, calendars, Drive, sites, stores, automation, administration, and events are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary REST methods
blocked.description: Arbitrary methods, paths, fields, filters, sorting, pages, batches, and raw REST access are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export Bitrix24 data
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, crawling, synchronization, batch APIs, and exports are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call another host
blocked.description: V1 accepts exact incoming webhook URLs only on documented Bitrix24 cloud zones; custom-domain and on-premise portals are excluded.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All three bounded identity and CRM reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact webhook-owner and portal binding, fixed methods and fields, provider permissions, limits, audits, redaction, and secret isolation remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three bounded approval-gated Bitrix24 reads and attaches the encrypted incoming webhook URL only on Railway.
Relay mounts three bounded approval-gated Bitrix24 reads and attaches the encrypted incoming webhook URL only on Railway.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Bitrix24 cloud portal or dedicated incoming webhook credential is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, a Bitrix24 administrator creates a dedicated incoming webhook owned by the intended least-privilege user with CRM permission, stores its URL through Relay, then validates portal and owner binding, profile and Deal reads, approval enforcement, permission denial, webhook rotation/deletion, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Bitrix24 documents permanent incoming webhook credentials and OAuth; webhook calls execute as the exact owner and remain limited by that user's rights and selected permissions.
Bitrix24 documents creating incoming webhooks, selecting tool permissions, the secret-bearing URL format, ownership transfer behavior, request statistics, and the requirement to keep the key private.
The profile method returns bounded current-owner identity metadata under the basic scope without parameters.

crm.item.list uses the CRM scope, respects the executing user's read permissions, supports explicit selected fields, fixed ordering and exact filters, and returns a static first page of at most fifty records.
Bitrix24 separates application or webhook scopes from user permissions and recommends selecting only scopes required by directly invoked methods.
Bitrix24 publishes the official cloud domain zones Relay allowlists for this V1 connection; custom-domain and on-premise portals remain excluded.
Bitrix24 publishes the service terms and incorporates its privacy policy; Relay uses only the documented REST mechanism and customer-authorized data.
